final: SELECT entrystat, AVG(avgmem), AVG(avgratio) FROM (SELECT p.zoneref AS zoneref, s.entrystat AS entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avgmem, AVG(CAST(p.procgpu AS REAL) / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avgratio FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.entrystat) GROUP BY entrystat
